[LUNI.14.9] **Not in v1.** The `complex` type is deferred: the clauses of this
section state it as it will be when it is built, and none of them binds v1. The
compiler must refuse each of its surface forms with
`DS_VALIDATE_COMPLEX_NOT_IN_V1`, naming the form:

- a slot whose type is written `complex`, with or without a unit
  ([LUNI.14.4]), where no declared type has that name;
- a numeric literal with a bare `i` or `j` suffix ([LLEX.12.7]);
- `i` or `j` as an interpolation format type ([LUNI.14.8]).

`i` and `j` stay withheld from unit suffixes ([LUNI.3.1.5]), so the literal
form remains free for the type when it is built.
